_comment: Which library sub-sections can hold quiz material, and the order they are listed in. Mike's rulings 2026-07-22: (1) the Quizzes editor lists only genuine advisory-content areas, so it never nags a firm to fill a gap that should not exist; (2) areas appear in the same order as the owner's own headers documents, not the order the export happens to store them in.
_source: The section headers documents the owner maintains in 'central frameworks/': 'Do the Job Content headers (5).pdf', 'Get Org. Headers.pdf', 'Get the Job Content Headers.pdf'.
_rule: sectionOrder ranks the sections. For each section, `restrictions` (if present) is BOTH the allow-list AND the running order; otherwise `subSectionOrder` gives the order without restricting. Anything not named falls to the end in export order, so a new area is never silently dropped or hidden.

_notLimited.Get the Job: All 8 sub-sections are advisory content per its headers document.
_notLimited.Get Organised: All 3 are advisory content. 'Firm Manager Access' and 'Advisor Access' sound like app permissions but its headers document describes real material — CA Capacity Planner, CA Firm Strategy, Leadership, Firm Board Pack, Coaching & Culture, Group Coaching Tutorials, Advisor Growth Plan.

_excludedFromDoTheJob.(blank): 2 pages carry no sub-section at all — 'Specialist Content 1' and 'Programme Pages'. They appear in no headers document. Shown before this rule under an invented heading, which misrepresented the library.
_excludedFromDoTheJob.External Advisors: 6 pages — Insurance, Legal, Loan Estimator, Retirement Calcs, Cost of Capital, Crypto Asset Allocations.
_excludedFromDoTheJob.Firm Manager Access: 3 pages — CA Firm Strategy, Leadership, Firm Board Pack. NOTE: the Get Organised headers document describes these three as Get Organised content, but the export files them under Do the Job. Flagged upstream, not corrected here.
_excludedFromDoTheJob.Risk Advisor Access: 1 page — Business Insurance Model. Same mismatch as above.

subSectionOrder._getTheJobNote: The Get the Job document is prose, not a clean numbered list — it runs Sales Tracker, Marketing, Seminar Delivery, Positioning, Learning to Sell, Pricing & Proposals. 'Sales Tracker' is not a sub-section in the export, and three real sub-sections go unmentioned; those three are appended in export order rather than guessed at.
subSectionOrder._getOrganisedNote: Its document runs Firm Manager Access content, then (Advisor) Access content, with the Risk Advisor material described inside the advisor section. This matches the export's own order.
